decision: Conditional: all exact-head mandatory workflow/job/test-step SUCCESS plus normal required checks and clean mergeability support normal dev merge. Current pending runs prevent green claim. Downloading passed stdout is not independently required by reviewed AGENTS.

instructions.AGENTS: chicago/4d/AGENTS.md:578 merge when dev gate green;718-724 both check and published desktop/mobile smoke, no weakened assertions;798 do not call skipped gate passed
instructions.split: Smoke source documents staged desktop/mobile execution; staged entrypoint retains nonzero exit for failures; workflow mandatory publish and node smoke commands have no if/continue-on-error.

required_before_merge: All18 unique smoke runs and canonical terminal SUCCESS at exact frozen SHA and expected workflow/ref/attempt
All18 smoke jobs AND actual publish/test steps completed SUCCESS, not skipped/neutral/cancelled; exact frozen workflow checkout and published command unchanged
Canonical humans and teamsters jobs both completed SUCCESS, with every mandatory build/export/browser/validation/inspection step completed SUCCESS; upload-only success insufficient
Durable18 unique viewport/range POST intents/204 successes plus discovered18 exact-head runs preserved; do not infer individual input pairing from order
Normal PR required checks SUCCESS on applicable source/merge head, PR mergeable/clean and no newer source head
Retain strict stdout-union validator false/unproven; do not equate metadata success to parsed assertion inventory or artifact/photographic acceptance
counterexamples: Workflow success with required job/test step skipped
continue-on-error or failure swallowed by shell/try catch yields misleading success
Wrong workflow/head/attempt or changed checkout ref
Duplicate dispatch inputs or missing range/viewport
Only generic humans job succeeds while teamsters is skipped
Publish step absent or smoke runs source rather than published mirror
Passed CI does not establish visual quality or downloaded artifact contents
limits: No passed stdout access: exact assertion names/counts, runtime viewport/stage headers and log-union arithmetic remain unproven
Dispatch-to-run individual input pairing unavailable from standard workflow metadata; must not assert it
No bypass of denied log host, no validator changes, no action authorized before all actual results green
